$Comment: The binding row for the Headless Horseman's fight (EncounterManager/Hallows_Eve/
Hallows_Eve_Headless_Horseman_Encounter.json): what the server owes for it, which the script never
describes. It names the fight (NameKey, on the bar's Records tab and every line that names it),
binds the boss the library credits through the script's Boss slot in both his forms, and keeps
the fight's records (wins, fastest win, best share, damage) on Records' Boss Fights under the
bucket hallows_eve_headless_horseman, split by how many fought him (ByPartySize), so a solo win
is never ranked against a party of five.
Participation decides each player's share of his daily Claim. A player's score is every point of
damage they deal his body (DamageDealt, the server rule's 1.0), every point they deal his Head and
his Jack Skeletons (DamageToAdds), every point they take while in the fight (DamageTaken) and every
second they spend in it (Presence), each times its weight; their share is that score against the
top player's. His body cannot be hurt while his head flies, so the Head and the skeletons weigh
the most: in a three-minute fight for three where two players split his body and one cuts his
one Head down and kills the skeletons, the cutter reads close to the top, a member who stands in
the graveyard and fights nothing about a quarter, and one who walks in for the last minute and
fights nothing less again. One player landing all the body damage pulls everyone else lower, and a
second Head puts the cutter on top. Raise DamageToAdds to pay the head work more, raise Presence to flatten
the shares, lower it to reward damage more.
Feedback names his own notices, the three Hallows_Eve_Horseman_* moments under FeedbackMoments:
a banner as the fight begins, a toast with each player's share when he falls, and a toast after
a wipe that says how his head works. His script sends no phase beats, so PhaseChanged is left
to the library and never shows.
It writes no Scale on purpose: his fight scales his health with the party itself, one step per
player, so a library scale here would scale him twice. No Loot either: his script pays his two
Claims. Switch the row off with Enabled false, or from mods/ziggfreedcommon/encounters.json under
the key hallows_eve_headless_horseman_encounter.
